BiblicalUsage: A young she-camel is the picture Jeremiah uses for Judah running after other gods. In Jeremiah 2:23 God says, see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways. A young camel, fast and restless, crossing and recrossing its own tracks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the young camel is a hard picture of my own wandering: swift, restless, and always running the wrong way until God calls me back.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
